description: A Kotlin class representing a simple 3x3 Tic Tac Toe board with operations to place marks, retrieve cell contents, clear the board, and check if the board is full.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: A class modeling the state and operations of a Tic Tac Toe game board.

methods.name: place
methods.description: Places a player's mark at a specified position if within bounds and cell is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the player at a specific cell, or null if empty or out of bounds.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the board by setting all cells to null.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Checks if the board is completely filled with players.
